heroSourceLine: Source: Jordan School District’s revised 2026–27 calendar · All-level PDF updated June 12, 2026
heroSummary: High school students in Jordan School District begin Tuesday, August 18, 2026, while seventh graders attend orientation. Elementary students and grades 8–9 begin August 19. Seventh grade ends June 3, one day before most students. Families should also check the grade-level calendars: the elementary version shows weekly Early Out days, while the high school calendar includes the daily A/B rotation.
calendarNotes: High school students begin August 18, the same day seventh graders attend orientation; elementary students and grades 8–9 begin August 19. Secondary fall conferences are September 23–24, followed by a September 25 compensation day, while elementary conferences are September 30–October 1, followed by an October 2 compensation day. Fall Recess is October 20–23 after a student-free grade-transmittal day. Winter Recess runs December 21–January 1, and Spring Recess runs March 29–April 2 after a March 26 grade-transmittal day. The elementary family calendar labels the last instructional day of most weeks as Early Out, and the high school calendar publishes daily A/B letters. Tentative November and March testing dates create different attendance rules for grades 10–12. Graduation runs June 1–3, seventh grade ends June 3, and most students finish June 4.

customSections.label: Two Inconsistencies in the Official 2026–27 Calendar
customSections.content: The revised all-level PDF contains two internal inconsistencies. Its summary ends Winter Recess on January 1, 2026, while the calendar grid correctly places the date in 2027. The summary lists Q2/Q3 as 46/47 days, but the grid reverses the counts to 47/46. Both versions total 180 instructional days. Because the PDF disagrees on the quarter split, we leave it unresolved.

whatsNew.title: 2026–27 Compared With 2025–26
content: The grade-level opening moves one day earlier: high school and seventh-grade orientation begin August 18, while elementary and grades 8–9 begin August 19.
The year ends June 4 again, but graduations expand from June 2–3 to June 1–3.
The Health & Wellness Virtual Day used in 2025–26 does not appear; February 5 is instead a no-school professional-development day.
Fall Recess shifts one day earlier to October 20–23, and Spring Recess shifts to March 29–April 2.

calendarFaqs.q: What happens if Jordan uses the emergency make-up day?
calendarFaqs.a: June 7, 2027, is a teacher check-out date and a conditional emergency make-up day. It becomes a student day only if district administration recommends using it and the Board approves the change.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 10, 2026, against the complete revised all-level PDF, grade-level family and school calendars, and the district's Board-approval note.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we verified the revised Jordan calendar
sourceReviewDetails: Jordan says its calendars are developed by a Board-approved committee and posted after Board approval. The district's calendar page says the 2026–27 revision was approved April 28, 2026; the all-level PDF is marked last updated June 12, 2026.
The elementary family and school calendars are marked updated July 16, 2026, so we use them for the latest Early Out information.
All three pages of the all-level PDF were visually reviewed because the A/B labels, grade-level color coding, and legend are not preserved reliably in text extraction.
We use January 1, 2027 for the end of Winter Recess because it follows December 2026 and appears in the January 2027 grid.
The summary page lists Q2/Q3 as 46/47 days while the calendar-grid captions list 47/46. Both versions total 180 instructional days, so the quarter split remains unresolved.
The detailed high school calendar identifies September 23 conferences as in person and September 24 as virtual and prints the full A/B rotation.
Tentative testing dates are listed by grade because they do not affect every high school student the same way.
The .ics file is a one-time import and does not update automatically or reproduce weekly early outs and daily A/B letters.
